movie.title: Ekis
movie.overview: Erik Matti’s classic Ekis gets a bold reboot with an all-girls ensemble led by Angela Morena, Cheena Dizon, and Aliya Raymundo. A crew of female thugs launches a kidnap-for-ransom plot, but when things go wrong, escaping the chaos becomes impossible.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A crew of female thugs plans a high-stakes kidnap-for-ransom plot that devolves into unstoppable chaos when their strategy unravels.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In this modern reboot of Erik Matti's classic, an all-female gang led by Angela Morena, Cheena Dizon, and Aliya Raymundo takes on a perilous kidnap-for-ransom operation. What begins as a calculated heist quickly spiraling out of control as unexpected complications arise. With tension escalating rapidly, the crew finds themselves trapped in a dangerous web where escaping the fallout becomes nearly impossible.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Directed as a bold, contemporary reinvention of Erik Matti’s original classic, Ekis reimagines the gritty crime drama through the lens of an all-female criminal ensemble. The narrative centers on a crew of street-smart female thugs, portrayed by Angela Morena, Cheena Dizon, and Aliya Raymundo, who hatch a lucrative kidnap-for-ransom scheme to secure a massive payday. Driven by desperation and ambition, the group meticulously plans the operation to ensure seamless execution. However, during the kidnapping, key elements fail to go as intended, triggering a rapid sequence of disastrous missteps. Tensions rise within the group as panic sets in and trust begins to fracture under intense stress. External threats intensify as law enforcement and dangerous underground rivals close in on their location. As the situation escalates into absolute mayhem, the boundaries between captors and victims blur. Desperate to survive, the crew must navigate a violent, claustrophobic spiral where every attempt to escape the surrounding chaos only traps them deeper.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Ekis is an intense crime drama reboot that reframes Erik Matti's original story around an all-female heist crew starring Angela Morena, Cheena Dizon, and Aliya Raymundo. The film follows a hardened group of female criminals who orchestrate a high-stakes kidnap-for-ransom operation designed to yield a life-changing payout. When unforeseen complications disrupt their plan mid-execution, the crew is plunged into an escalating crisis where betrayal, danger, and chaotic fallout threaten to destroy them all from within.

story_structure.climax: The situation reaches its absolute boiling point in a violent, high-tension showdown where survival becomes the ultimate and improbable goal.
story_structure.conflict: The kidnapping scheme hits an unexpected snag, instantly spiraling out of control and setting the crew against powerful external threats and mounting internal tension.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the catastrophe, the surviving crew members must face the inescapable consequences of their reckless enterprise.
story_structure.introduction: A crew of female thugs, led by a fierce ensemble, operates in the gritty underworld and decides to execute a high-stakes kidnap-for-ransom plan.
story_structure.risingAction: As chaos unfolds, desperate attempts to regain control lead to dangerous confrontations, compounding bad decisions, and a rapidly shrinking window of escape.
